text_blocks.snippet: Jardiance (empagliflozin) can cause mild issues like urinary tract infections and yeast infections, as well as rare, serious risks like diabetic ketoacidosis.
snippet_highlighted_words: urinary tract infections and yeast infections

text_blocks.snippet: You can read full safety details on the Jardiance Side Effects Page.

list.snippet: Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Burning, pain, or frequent urination.
Genital yeast infections: Itching, burning, and discharge in women or men.
Increased urination: Passing urine more often or in larger amounts.
Increased thirst: Feeling very thirsty due to fluid loss.
Joint pain: Mild discomfort in the joints.
Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A dangerous buildup of acid in the blood, marked by nausea, vomiting, fruity breath, and trouble breathing.
Necrotizing fasciitis (Fournier’s gangrene): A severe, fast-spreading infection of the tissue between and around the genitals and anus.
Dehydration and low blood pressure: Extreme fluid loss causing dizziness, fainting, or kidney injury.
Severe kidney infections: Pain in the lower back, fever, and blood in the urine.
Lower limb amputations: Increased risk of pain, sores, or infections on the legs and feet.
Severe allergic reactions: Rash, hives, or swelling of the face and throat.
